RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong username or password, or too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN: This request was refused for security reasons.
SENSITIVE_MODE_FORBIDDEN: Sensitive modes are locked for this universe.
CLASSIFICATION_FORBIDDEN: This character is permanently excluded from sensitive modes and cannot be classified as a verified adult.
CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Tick the confirmation box to classify a character as a verified adult.
JUSTIFICATION_REQUIRED: Write a longer justification before classifying a character as a verified adult.
RESTORE_CONFLICT: This was changed again since then, so it cannot be restored automatically.
RESTORE_NOT_ALLOWED: This change cannot be restored. A verified-adult classification must always be entered by hand.
INELIGIBLE_CONTENT: This content is not eligible for this mode.
AUDIENCE_FORBIDDEN: The code fixes this universe as young-audience: it cannot be classified as general audience.
INVALID_IMAGE: This file is not a usable picture. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP that is not damaged, not animated, and large enough.
DUPLICATE_IMAGE: This picture was already imported for this character.
INVALID_SEQUENCE: Some frames are not valid for this picture and ratio. Generate the sequence again.
SEQUENCE_REQUIRED: Save a sequence before approving this image.
APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED: The rules do not allow this approval right now.
